senses.gloss: m. (נָצַב; cmp. יַצִּיבָא) permanent resident, opp. גֵּר.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64:3-4">Gen. R. s. 64</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="U01174"><he>שְׁכֹן</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 26:2">Gen. XXVI, 2</cite>) <he>עשה שכונה הוי נוטע הוי זורע הוי נ׳ …</he> make a settlement in the land of Israel, be a planter, be a sower, be a citizen.
